summary: Retested the 8 fixes from iteration 3. 6 are fixed, 1 is partly fixed and 1 is still broken. Fixed: (1) a 16'11" (203 in) profile is accepted by /api/agent and /api/voice, including the real UI voice flow, and 204 in returns 422; (2) gibberish destinations return status chat with a 'couldn't find that destination' reply and no route, in both API and UI; (3) opening /truck-profile directly after a reload shows the saved values; (4) Back and Save on /truck-profile with no history go to '/'; (5) 'Port of Oakland' and 'Pilot travel center Lodi' resolve to the businesses through HERE Discover (here- ids); (6) HERE notices are deduplicated friendly text; (7) POST /api/route with category destination returns parking null. Partly fixed (8): the ft/in units are visible, the web focus outline is gone, city destinations are not duplicated and the default chip '13'6" · 53' · 80k lb' fits at 375 px. Still broken: with HAZMAT on, the chip truncates to '16'11" · 53' · 80k l…' at 375 px, so the HAZMAT state is not visible. Also new: name and address are duplicated for HERE Discover places, for example 'Port of Oakland' / 'Port of Oakland, 530 Water St…'. Regression passes: Reno route_set with source here and truck_aware true; 'I need fuel' route_set with satellite parking and 3 options. All backend tests pass (72 existing + 11 new). No deprecated Expo packages found (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch, SafeAreaView).

minor.issue: The HERE Discover address.label starts with the place title ('Port of Oakland, 530 Water St, Oakland, CA 94607-3524, United States'; 'Pilot Travel Center, 15100 N Thornton Rd…'). Place.address repeats Place.name and the UI shows it twice. Strip a leading '<title>, ' from addr. Reference: /app/backend/services/geocode.py:46

ui_bugs.issue: At 375 px the chip text area is 131 px wide but the hazmat label needs 199 px, so '16'11" · 53' · 80k lb · HAZMAT' renders as '16'11" · 53' · 80k l…' and HAZMAT is cut off. This was an action item from iteration 3 and is still open. The default label fits exactly (125/125 px). Possible fixes: show hazmat as an icon or badge, use a smaller font, drop the pencil icon or the ' lb' suffix. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TopBar.tsx:30-34,68

integration_issues.flow: Voice request with an out-of-range stored profile
integration_issues.issue: useTruckProfile.load() merges localStorage without validating it. If storage holds height_in 300, the chip shows 25'0", /api/voice returns 422 and the UI silently returns to 'Where to next?' with no message. The iteration 3 item 'surface 422 as Check your truck profile' was not done: there is no 422 handling in src/api.ts or in the screens. Low impact, because the editor now blocks invalid values.

action_items: TopBar chip: make HAZMAT visible at 375 px, for example as a compact hazard icon or badge instead of the ' · HAZMAT' text, or shrink the font or drop the pencil icon. Today '16'11" · 53' · 80k lb · HAZMAT' is truncated.
geocode.py _here_item: strip the leading title from the HERE Discover address label so the CopilotSheet does not show 'Port of Oakland' twice.
Optional: clamp or validate the stored truck profile in useTruckProfile.load(), and map a 422 from /voice or /agent to 'Check your truck profile'.
critical_code_review_comments: truck-profile.tsx: the useEffect on [truck] resets the fields whenever the shared profile changes. That is fine today because only load and save emit, but it would overwrite in-progress edits if another emitter is added.

geocode: an ambiguous 'take me to Springfield' quietly picks Springfield, Sonora CA (92 mi) without asking which one. That is acceptable with location bias, but worth confirming with the driver for common city names.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (7/8 retest items fully pass; chip HAZMAT truncation still open)

seed_data_creation: None. TTS fixture audio was generated into /tmp (reno.mp3, gib.mp3, oak.b64, fuel.b64).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fake mic: loop=true now produces an empty transcript, because the Whisper compression_ratio filter drops repeated text. Use src.loop=false with src.start(ctx.currentTime+0.6), tap copilot-avatar-button, wait 3.5–5.5 s, then tap again. Read the base64 mp3 from /tmp/*.b64 inside the script and pass it to localStorage key __fake_mp3 before page.reload(). Generate new phrases with services.voice.synthesize (see /tmp/mk2.py). Run the tests with: export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=...; pytest tests/ -n 4.
rca_of_issue: Chip truncation: profileWrap uses flex:1 between two 56 px buttons, which leaves about 131 px for text at 375 px, but the hazmat label is about 199 px at fontSize 15. Duplicated name/address: HERE Discover address.label is formatted '<title>, <street>, …'.
